Post Text:
Hi Everyone,
I’m currently building a beauty Shopify store (based in the Netherlands 🇳🇱) and I’ve hit a bit of a wall.
I’ve been using CJ Dropshipping, but the shipping costs to the EU are really killing my margins, especially on beauty products where the price per item is already low.
I like the platform for sourcing, but between shipping fees + delivery times, it’s getting hard to make the numbers work.
Is anyone here dealing with the same issue in Europe?
I’d really appreciate advice on:
Better suppliers for EU/Netherlands shipping
Ways to reduce shipping costs (without losing too much delivery speed)
Or any alternative strategies you’re using for beauty niches
Still learning and trying to make it sustainable, so any help would mean a lot 🙏
Thanks in advance!
